info.title: SchoolBridge API
info.description: WhatsApp-first school-parent communication platform. All 2xx responses (except 204) are wrapped: { "data": T, "meta": PageMeta | null }. Errors use RFC 7807 ProblemDetail. Tenancy is carried by the bearer token — no tenant header is required.

tags.name: Announcements
tags.description: School-wide and class-level announcements with multi-channel delivery

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Staff and platform-admin authentication (email/password + JWT refresh)

tags.name: Devices
tags.description: FCM push notification device token registration

tags.name: Students
tags.description: Student roster management and bulk import

tags.name: Teacher Subject Assignments
tags.description: Assign teachers to subjects within a class

tags.name: Schools
tags.description: Platform-admin school (tenant) management. All endpoints require SUPER_ADMIN.

tags.name: WhatsApp Diagnostics
tags.description: WhatsApp integration status and credential check (SUPER_ADMIN only)

tags.name: School Users
tags.description: Platform-admin user management within a school tenant. Requires SUPER_ADMIN.

tags.name: WhatsApp Webhook
tags.description: Meta Cloud API webhook for delivery receipts and status updates. No bearer token is required — requests are authenticated by HMAC-SHA256 signature.

tags.name: Class Subjects
tags.description: Assign and manage subjects within a class

tags.name: Grades
tags.description: Grade records management and parent read access

tags.name: Attendance
tags.description: Daily attendance marking and parent-response flow

get.description: Returns configurable settings for a school (timezone, quiet hours, etc.).

put.description: Replaces the school's settings. All fields must be supplied.

get.description: Called by Meta when a webhook subscription is registered or refreshed. Returns the hub.challenge value if hub.verify_token matches the configured secret.

403.description: hub.mode is not 'subscribe' or verify_token mismatch

post.description: Called by Meta for every message status transition (sent, delivered, read, failed). The raw request body is verified against the X-Hub-Signature-256 HMAC header before processing. Duplicate events are deduplicated via Redis (TTL 24h).

parameters.name: X-Hub-Signature-256
parameters.description: HMAC-SHA256 signature: 'sha256=<hex>' computed over the raw body using WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET

200.description: Event accepted (always returned to Meta to suppress retries)

409.description: Subject name already exists in this school

get.description: Returns a paginated list of all students for the school, newest first.

post.description: Creates a single student record for the school.

Accepts a UTF-8 CSV file with header: externalId,fullName,dateOfBirth,className. Valid rows are created; invalid rows are collected and returned in the response body rather than aborting the whole import. HTTP 200 is returned even when some rows fail.

422.description: File missing or not a valid CSV

200.description: Import completed; check body for per-row errors

get.description: Returns a paginated list of all schools on the platform, newest first.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by school status; omit to return all

post.description: Provisions a new school tenant on the platform. The school is created in ACTIVE status.

409.description: A school with the same slug already exists

get.description: Returns a paginated list of all users in the school, newest first.

post.description: Creates a staff member (SCHOOL_ADMIN / TEACHER) or parent in the given school. Staff require email + password; parents require phone (OTP login, no password).

409.description: Email or phone already in use

post.description: Marks a school as SUSPENDED. Suspended schools cannot authenticate new tokens.
Restores a SUSPENDED school to ACTIVE status.

409.description: School is not in a suspended state

post.summary: Verify OTP and obtain parent token
post.description: Exchanges a valid ticket + 6-digit code for a 24-hour sliding-TTL bearer token. Include this token in the Authorization header for all subsequent parent requests.

400.description: Invalid or expired ticket / wrong code

post.description: Sends a 6-digit OTP via WhatsApp to the registered phone number. Returns a ticket ID regardless of whether the phone is known (anti-enumeration). Rate-limited per phone number.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded for this phone number

post.description: Revokes the parent session token. Idempotent.

204.description: Logged out (or token was already invalid)

post.description: Links a parent user to a student, recording their relationship type and whether they are the primary contact. A parent may be linked to multiple students; each link is a separate record.

409.description: Link already exists for this parent-student pair

404.description: Parent user or student not found

get.description: Returns the homework feed for the specified child. 404 if the parent is not linked to the child (anti-enumeration).

parameters.name: childId
parameters.description: ID of the child to fetch homework for

post.description: Creates a homework item as DRAFT (default) or PUBLISHED (when publish=true). PUBLISHED items immediately materialize HomeworkRecipient rows for every linked parent of every enrolled student in the class.
Transitions a DRAFT homework item to PUBLISHED and materializes recipient rows. 409 if already PUBLISHED or ARCHIVED.
Records a parent's acknowledgment. No-op when requiresAck=false. 404 if the parent has no recipient row for this item.

404.description: Parent has no recipient row for this homework item

get.description: Returns all grade records for the given student. Parents receive 403 if they are not linked to the student (anti-enumeration).

409.description: Grade already exists for this combination

post.summary: Register or refresh a device push token
post.description: Upserts the FCM token for the authenticated user's device. Call this on app startup and whenever the mobile SDK rotates the token.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of all classes for the school, newest first.

post.description: Creates a new school class for the tenant.

post.summary: Assign a subject to a class

409.description: Subject already assigned to this class

get.summary: List teachers assigned to a subject in a class

post.summary: Assign a teacher to a subject in a class

409.description: Teacher already assigned to this subject in this class

404.description: Class, subject, or teacher not found

get.description: Returns all active student enrollments for the class. SCHOOL_ADMIN sees all classes; TEACHER sees only their assigned classes.

403.description: Requires SCHOOL_ADMIN or teacher assigned to the class

post.description: Creates an enrollment record linking a student to a class.

409.description: Student is already enrolled in this class

post.description: Rotates the refresh token and returns a new access token. The old refresh token is immediately revoked (single-use).
Revokes the refresh token. Idempotent — unknown tokens succeed silently.

204.description: Logged out (or token was already invalid)

post.description: Returns a short-lived JWT access token and a 30-day refresh token.

post.summary: Submit parent response to absence alert
post.description: Records a parent's explanation or acknowledgment for an absence alert. The parent must be linked to the student on the attendance record; unlinked parents receive 404 (anti-enumeration).

404.description: Attendance record not found or parent not linked (anti-enumeration)

post.description: Records an attendance status (PRESENT, ABSENT, LATE, EXCUSED) for a single student on the given date. SCHOOL_ADMIN may mark any class; TEACHER may only mark classes they are assigned to.

403.description: Requires SCHOOL_ADMIN or teacher assigned to the class

post.description: Bulk marks every enrolled student in the class as PRESENT for the given date. Students who already have an attendance record for the date are skipped.

403.description: Requires SCHOOL_ADMIN or teacher assigned to the class

200.description: Bulk mark completed; see body for counts

get.description: Returns a paginated list of all announcements for the school, newest first. Filter by status to narrow results.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by announcement status; omit to return all statuses

post.description: Creates and fans out an announcement to matching parent recipients. SCHOOL_ADMIN may use any scope (SCHOOL, GRADE, CLASS, CUSTOM). TEACHER may only use CLASS scope for a class they are assigned to. Recipients are derived from linked parents of enrolled students matching the scope.

403.description: Insufficient permissions or scope not allowed for role

422.description: Invalid scope combination or body validation error

post.description: Marks the announcement as RECALLED. Already-delivered messages are not retracted from recipients' devices.

409.description: Announcement is already recalled or in a non-recallable state

post.description: Records a parent's acknowledgment for an announcement where requiresAck=true. Idempotent — re-acknowledging the same announcement is a no-op.

403.description: Parent is not a recipient of this announcement

409.description: Subject name already exists in this school

get.description: Returns a single student by ID.

delete.description: Deletes a student. Enrollments and parent links are cascade-deleted.

patch.description: Partially updates a student record. Only provided fields are changed.

get.description: Returns a homework item. Parents receive 404 if their child is not a recipient (anti-enumeration).

404.description: Not found or parent not a recipient (anti-enumeration)

delete.description: Soft-deletes by transitioning status to ARCHIVED. HomeworkRecipient rows are retained for parent-feed history.

patch.description: Updates subject, description, attachmentKey, and dueDate on a DRAFT or PUBLISHED item. Recipients are not re-materialized. 409 if ARCHIVED.

409.description: Item is ARCHIVED and cannot be modified

get.description: Returns a single class by ID.

delete.description: Deletes a class. Enrollments and teacher assignments are cascade-deleted.

patch.description: Partially updates a class. Only provided fields are changed.

get.description: Shows credential configuration and which client is active
Sends the OTP template to the given E.164 phone (e.g. +201234567890). Only works with live credentials and approved templates.
Calls Meta Graph API to verify the access token and phone number ID. Returns the phone's display name on success.

get.summary: Get subjects available to a student
get.description: Returns all subjects from classes the student is enrolled in, with assigned teacher.
Returns a single user by ID within the school.
Returns a single school by ID.
Returns the children linked to the authenticated parent, each enriched with their current class enrolments. Returns an empty list when no children are linked.

get.summary: List parent links for a student
get.description: Returns all parent-student links for the given student.
Returns all recipient rows for a homework item, including delivery status and acknowledgment timestamp. Only the item's author teacher or a SCHOOL_ADMIN can access this endpoint.

get.summary: List all teacher-subject assignments for a class

get.description: Returns all classes assigned to the authenticated teacher — both as homeroom teacher and via explicit TeacherAssignment records.
Returns a paginated list of classes where the given user is the homeroom teacher.
Returns a single attendance record by ID.
Returns the attendance entry for every enrolled student in a class on the given date. Students with no record yet appear with status UNKNOWN.

parameters.name: classId
parameters.description: Class ID to fetch the roster for

403.description: Requires SCHOOL_ADMIN or teacher assigned to the class

get.description: Returns attendance records for a student across an inclusive date range. SCHOOL_ADMIN and TEACHER see all records; a PARENT must be linked to the student (unlinked parents receive 404 instead of 403 to prevent enumeration).

404.description: Student not found or parent not linked (anti-enumeration)

403.description: Requires SCHOOL_ADMIN, TEACHER, or linked PARENT

get.description: Returns a single announcement by ID.

403.description: Not the sender and not SCHOOL_ADMIN

get.description: Returns the materialized recipient rows for an announcement, including per-recipient delivery status (QUEUED→SENT→DELIVERED→READ) and acknowledgment timestamp.

delete.description: Deletes the link between a parent and a student.
Removes a student from a class by deleting the enrollment record.
Marks the device token inactive so it no longer receives push notifications.

404.description: Device not found for this user

delete.summary: Remove a subject from a class

409.description: Cannot remove: teacher assignments reference this class-subject

ProblemDetail.description: RFC 7807 ProblemDetail — returned for all 4xx/5xx responses

ParentToken.description: Opaque 24-hour sliding-TTL token issued by POST /api/v1/parents/auth/verify-otp.
